candidates.exact_problem: A VLA follows the visually familiar LIBERO behavior instead of a plausible counterfactual instruction in the same scene.
candidates.why_it_matters: Manipulation policies that ignore goal language can execute the wrong valid-looking task even when vision and control remain nominal.
candidates.closest_primary_prior: When Vision Overrides Language: Evaluating and Mitigating Counterfactual Failures in VLAs (LIBERO-CF and CAG)
candidates.official_checkpoint_availability: CAG training-free code is public; optional unconditioned pi0/pi0.5/OpenVLA-OFT checkpoints are public, but no X-VLA-specific CAG checkpoint exists.
candidates.benchmark_protocol: Official LIBERO-CF condition-specific touch and success on spatial, object, long, focused, and OOD suites with matched scene conditions.
candidates.expected_base: Locally runnable X-VLA or quantized OpenVLA-OFT with measurable standard competence but biased counterfactual behavior.
candidates.expected_prior: Training-free CAG conditioned/unconditioned dual-branch action guidance.
candidates.residual_hypothesis: CAG improves instructed-object grounding but leaves phase- and task-dependent faithful-success residuals.
candidates.diagnostic_headroom: Official results report large faithful-versus-biased gaps, including OpenVLA-OFT average faithful success 0.4% versus biased success 78.6%.
candidates.local_compute_path: Sequential two-branch inference on the existing low-memory X-VLA or OpenVLA-OFT INT4 path; no physical robot.
candidates.method_novelty_opportunity: Only a mechanism beyond final-action CAG and the archived pathwise LIFT formulation would be eligible.
candidates.strongest_reviewer_objection: The thesis directly overlaps LIBERO-CF/CAG and the archived local LIFT/language-guidance family; a new method could be an obvious guidance variant.
candidates.stage0_falsification_test: Reject if official LIBERO-CF Base failure is not repeatable, CAG saturates it, or canonicalization/ordinary adaptation explains the residual.
candidates.stage_a_path: Paired official LIBERO-CF closed-loop Base/CAG/Ours/ablation/control evaluation only after a verified CAG residual.
candidates.pareto_opportunity: Comparable faithful success with a single-branch or lower-latency deployment path.
candidates.second_condition_or_backbone: LIBERO-Para or a held-out LIBERO-CF suite; quantized OpenVLA-OFT INT4 if X-VLA is primary.
candidates.camera_only_relevance: Optional non-actuated instruction-sensitivity validation on tabletop images after positive simulation evidence.
candidates.archived_route_overlap: High: TG-7D language/target, LCG, and especially CAG-anchored LIFT. This is not selected and none of those formulations is reopened.

candidates.exact_problem: Action-chunk VLAs execute actions computed from stale observations while a new chunk is inferred, degrading closed-loop reactivity under nonzero inference delay and longer execution horizons.
candidates.why_it_matters: Consumer-GPU inference latency creates a policy-control mismatch even when the same policy is competent under synchronous execution.
candidates.closest_primary_prior: Leave No Observation Behind: Real-time Correction for VLA Action Chunks (A2C2)
candidates.official_checkpoint_availability: Official LIBERO code is public, including residual dataset generation, residual-transformer training, and evaluation; the README does not identify a released residual checkpoint, so local training is required.
candidates.benchmark_protocol: Official LIBERO Spatial closed-loop success across fixed inference delays and execution horizons; paper evaluates ten tasks with repeated rollouts and reports A2C2 gains over naive asynchronous execution and RTC.
candidates.expected_base: Existing official SmolVLA-LIBERO checkpoint with measurable synchronous competence and delay-dependent degradation.
candidates.expected_prior: Official A2C2 residual correction head using current observation, stale base action/chunk, base hidden representation, language, and sinusoidal chunk position.
candidates.residual_hypothesis: A2C2 improves fixed-delay reactivity but leaves task- and delay-dependent residuals under the local consumer-GPU timing regime.
candidates.diagnostic_headroom: The paper reports +23 percentage points over RTC on dynamic Kinetix, +7 points on LIBERO Spatial, and a remaining pi0.5 gap under delay; the local Base-delay gap is directly measurable.
candidates.local_compute_path: Existing official SmolVLA environment/checkpoint, frozen Base, lightweight residual transformer, cached/canonical LeRobot LIBERO data, RTX 5080, gradient accumulation if needed.
candidates.method_novelty_opportunity: Only after a verified A2C2 residual: a distinct single core mechanism targeting the observed variable-delay residual, not another queue scheduler, generic residual MLP, or renamed EAC.
candidates.strongest_reviewer_objection: A new method may collapse to A2C2, RTC, fixed short replanning, or an ordinary residual head; EAC already closed generic adaptive queue scheduling.
candidates.stage0_falsification_test: Reject if SmolVLA has no repeated delay-induced loss, official A2C2 cannot improve the same matched condition, or no residual remains after A2C2.
candidates.stage_a_path: Paired official LIBERO Spatial closed-loop episodes across matched reset identities for synchronous Base, delayed Base, official A2C2 Prior, and later Ours arms only if a residual is verified.
candidates.pareto_opportunity: Performance superiority under delay, or noninferiority to A2C2 with materially lower latency/memory/checkpoint cost.
candidates.second_condition_or_backbone: A preregistered unseen delay distribution or execution horizon; X-VLA transfer only after positive SmolVLA Stage B and interface compatibility.
candidates.camera_only_relevance: Optional latency/action-stability measurement on prerecorded or live non-actuated camera streams after positive simulation evidence.
candidates.archived_route_overlap: Moderate: EAC tested entropy-based queue scheduling without injected inference delay or per-step current-observation action correction; TL-ChunkRepair/retiming altered existing chunks without a trained official A2C2 prior. Those formulations remain closed.

candidates.exact_problem: Frame-conditioned action-chunk policies resample incompatible short-horizon intents when visually similar observations require different actions because of recent task context.
candidates.why_it_matters: Inter-chunk intent switching can break coherent long-horizon manipulation even when each isolated observation is valid.
candidates.closest_primary_prior: IntentVLA: Short-Horizon Intent Modeling for Aliased Robot Manipulation
candidates.official_checkpoint_availability: AliasBench task code is public, but the official repository states that IntentVLA model code, training configs, and evaluation scripts are coming soon; no official model checkpoint is released.
candidates.benchmark_protocol: AliasBench on RoboTwin2, twelve tasks in four aliasing families with 100 trajectories per task; reported training uses 16 H100 GPUs, 30K steps, and batch 16 per GPU.
candidates.expected_prior: History-conditioned IntentVLA once official model code/checkpoint exists.
candidates.residual_hypothesis: Compact intent memory may still fail on long or cross-task aliases.
candidates.diagnostic_headroom: Official results report 10.4% for direct four-frame history, 28.1% for uniform history, and 45.8% for IntentVLA.
candidates.local_compute_path: No defensible current path: RoboTwin2/AliasBench assets and a compatible local prior are absent, and official training is far beyond local compute.
candidates.method_novelty_opportunity: Potential intent representation beyond generic history heads, but unavailable official prior prevents fair local residual verification.
candidates.strongest_reviewer_objection: The campaign already tested many temporal/history heads, and without official model code a local port would be both under-resourced and hard to distinguish.
candidates.stage0_falsification_test: Reject before implementation if the official prior remains unavailable or AliasBench cannot be run locally within the fixed budget.
candidates.stage_a_path: Official RoboTwin2 AliasBench paired closed-loop evaluation, currently unavailable locally.
candidates.pareto_opportunity: Lower-memory history compression than direct multi-frame VLA input.
candidates.second_condition_or_backbone: LIBERO-Long or RoboCasa after AliasBench success.
candidates.camera_only_relevance: Potential non-actuated intent-consistency diagnostics, but not a substitute for AliasBench success.
candidates.archived_route_overlap: High: PSE, MTF, CALA, NICE, HEST, HASTE, TSC, and other temporal/history mechanisms. A new official benchmark is conceptually useful but does not make the prior locally executable.

selection_adjudication.tie_break_justification: The selected delay thesis has an executable official SmolVLA prior implementation at a pinned commit, a direct local closed-loop perturbation surface, and a correction mechanism not tested by the closed EAC scheduler. The slightly lower-scoring language thesis reuses CAG as the exact prior already anchoring archived LIFT and would enter a much more crowded overlap boundary. Intent aliasing fails the local-executability hard filter.

next_authorized_action: Freeze and execute official-prior-first ASYNC_DELAY_REACTIVITY problem verification with runnable SmolVLA Base and official A2C2 prior. Do not design Ours until VERIFIED_PRIOR_RESIDUAL.
